violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety with RIDOH. Application was on site partially filled out. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Baked goods and calzones packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Guidance document provided. All information on guidance document shall be on labels. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The prep unit flip top was not in good repair. Tape was used to hold insulation up. Per PIC new flip top was ordered. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety with RIDOH. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Calzones/stromboli was observed held below 135 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, food was placed in units recently. All foods under 135 were reheated. It was observed that the foods were being stored on sheet rack for anywhere between 5-30 minutes after being cooked before placed in hot hold units. Food should be moved immediately to hot hold unit. Food should also only be stored on a single layer to ensure all product maintains temperature. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Meatballs and chicken which was prepped roughly 4 hours ago was placed hot in the refrigerator in covered containers greater than four inches deep. Food was observed around 60 degrees. Food was placed on sheet pan and moved to walk-in freezer. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Baked goods packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Guidance document provided. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
The prep unit flip top was observed in poor repair. The insulation of the top was falling down due to missing screw. Flip top to be repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the sanitizing solution. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving have an accumulation of debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

All food was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Date stickers were on site at the time of inspection. Establishment must have a method of date marking product. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024

Cookies and calzones packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. Self closing hinges were purchased and on site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2024

Staff failed to sanitize equipment and utensils after washing and rinsing them. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2024

Various calzones were observed held below 135 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food was reheated. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2024

Various foods were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Date dot stickers were purchased. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2024

The door to the outside is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New screens were purchased and on site at the time of inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2024
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. Self closing hinges will be purchased. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2024

The FRP walls in the oven area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Facility is lacking stoppers. Stoppers have been purchased. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2024

Staff failed to sanitize equipment and utensils after washing and rinsing them. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. 3-bay poster provided. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2024
